title: `obj_make_compatible` has cyclomatic complexity 25 (threshold: 15)
detail: Lizard reports CCN=25 for `obj_make_compatible` (36 lines). The function encodes object version compatibility logic through a deep if/elif chain over version strings. Each nova release adds another branch, making this a perpetual complexity hot-spot. Suggested fix: replace the nested version comparisons with a version-dispatch table mapping each version to the fields it removes or transforms.
